title: Within-person networks of clinical features of social anxiety disorder during cognitive and interpersonal therapy
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Limited number of repeated observations per patient (M = 19.6, range = 18-21) may lead to biased estimates; - No correction for multiple testing; - Centrality measures developed for social networks may not fully capture psychological network dynamics; - Time lag of half-week may not capture fast effects of SAD processes; - Sample may not be generalizable due to higher symptom severity and unemployment rates.
notes: The paper does not explicitly mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available in supplementary materials. The visualization packages are not specified in the paper.
